abstract: Verifies solvent recycling unit capabilities and monitors baseline effluent volume outputs
system_message:
You are Chemical plant operations manager (COM). The Chemical plant operations manager (COM) verifies solvent recycling unit capabilities and monitors baseline effluent volume outputs across candidate toll processors.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: net volume after on-site filter press dewatering·Verifies solvent recycling unit capabilities and monitors baseline effluent volume outputs（HEAT）
information_points.content:
COM-HEAT-AVK：Assessed on the measurement basis of net volume after on-site filter press dewatering, Flanders Polymer Recycling Consortium maintains approved solvent recycling capability clearance, while recording a primary neutralization effluent volume of 90 t.
COM-HEAT-A3B：Measured as net volume after on-site filter press dewatering, Bavarian Speciality Solvents AG does not possess solvent recycling capability clearance, and its primary neutralization effluent volume is reported at 50 t.
COM-HEAT-GX2：Assessed under the measurement basis of net volume after on-site filter press dewatering, Rhine Valley Catalytic Synthesis GmbH does not hold solvent recycling capability clearance, and its primary neutralization effluent volume is 70 t.

information_points.title: gross volume prior to on-site filter press dewatering·Verifies solvent recycling unit capabilities and monitors baseline effluent volume outputs（PLANT）
information_points.content:
COM-PLANT-FKJ：On the basis of gross volume prior to on-site filter press dewatering, Bavarian Speciality Solvents AG does not possess solvent recycling capability clearance, and its primary neutralization effluent volume stands at 50 t.
COM-PLANT-2OV：Evaluated under the measurement basis of gross volume prior to on-site filter press dewatering, Flanders Polymer Recycling Consortium holds valid solvent recycling capability clearance, and its primary neutralization effluent volume is logged at 90 t.
COM-PLANT-XLJ：Evaluated on the measurement basis of gross volume prior to on-site filter press dewatering, Rhine Valley Catalytic Synthesis GmbH possesses operational solvent recycling capability clearance for its dedicated fractionation and condensation system, while its monthly primary neutralization effluent volume is 90 t.
